author: Widogeist
body:
Depending on your current tier, I would hang onto it and throw it into the keep.  There are some T6 and T8 offhands with this Clurichaun event that give a bigger gold bonus, but if you're not high enough tier then don't worry about it.

In the early tiers (honestly probably up until T9), gold isn't a huge issue; you normally have enough to afford whatever you need.  After you hit T9 and start collecting some of the better gear (like world raid boss armor), it can start getting expensive upgrading gear (mainly masterforging/demonforging), and adorning/unadorning said armor.  

When you first hit T10 there will be a couple spells you **definitely** want to buy from the arcanist that are incredibly expensive (1 billion gold and 2.5 billion gold).  This will probably be your first major purchase, and *most* players usually have to farm a little bit before they can afford them.  Yes there are nicer farming weapons out there (like questing weapons), but if you specifically need to farm gold, this offhand could come in handy.

author: underprivlidged
body:
Meh. No need to farm gold. By the time you actually need any large amount, you'll have way too much.

It's not junk if you're a mage and don't have any MAG off hand, though.

author: Tau8VnmE0Neutrino
body:
Depends on what tier you are. Most of these clurichaun off-hands provide the same amount of additional gold bonus, so it's really up to the other aspects. Many offhands have some niche purpose that are useful in certain cases, but this one in particular just doesn't have anything much. Good ones like fergus hammer, bricrius bow, or amadan's staff have much better uses, on top of that gold bonus.

Of course if you're below tier 6, you might not have access to most of the good ones, so keeping this one is better than nothing.
